sections:
These days, the space industry is expanding more and more. In 2021, there was a major news story. The first Japanese tourists stayed on the International Space Station (ISS), a satellite orbiting 400 kilometers above the Earth. More people will enjoy traveling to space and even staying on the moon someday.

However, there are still many challenges to space exploration. One of them is food supply. In the early days of space development, there were very few varieties of space food. Astronauts ate bite-sized solid food or a tube of jelly which had only the necessary nutrition. Whether they liked it or not, there were no other choices.

Recently, the variety and taste of space food has greatly improved. It also includes Japanese food such as instant ramen noodles and canned mackerel. Even in space, people can now enjoy what they eat on Earth and feel closer to home.

In 2019, the Artemis program was announced. Its purpose includes building a moon base for space exploration. One of the challenges of the program is addressing food supply. Though space food has improved greatly in variety and taste, there are still many difficulties to overcome.

Traditionally, space food was transported from Earth. However, this is very expensive. In fact, transporting one kilogram of cargo to the ISS costs about 3.3 million yen. Moreover, the amount of food that can be carried is limited and fresh food cannot be stored for long. It is more difficult to transport large quantities of space food to the moon, which is much farther away than the ISS.

How can we get food so far away from Earth? One clear solution is producing food in space. Researchers have been experimenting with what food could be grown beyond our planet.

One project is growing vegetables in plastic bags. In 2021, lettuce cultivation research was carried out on the Japanese Experiment Module of the ISS. Lettuce was grown in sealed bags in space for the first time. The experiment was successful, and it was harvested.

The cultivation procedure is simple. Lettuce seeds and fertilizer are put in plastic bags. When the bags are placed in the cultivation device, the plants are automatically watered. After a month or two, the lettuce is ready to harvest.

There are clear advantages of cultivating vegetables in plastic bags. First of all, since the vegetables are grown in plastic, contamination or bad odors can be prevented. In addition, the simple equipment is easy to transport from Earth because it does not take up much room in the spacecraft. This simple and efficient system is useful to supply food during moon exploration.

Another project is building underground farms on the moon. Moon sand is not good for farming because microorganisms cannot survive in it. However, through various steps, researchers were able to make the sand porous. This allowed microorganisms to grow in the soil. Finally, they succeeded in growing vegetables in the processed sand. This technology will be a great help to the moon farm project.

Food production technologies in space will not only help space exploration but can also support agriculture on our planet. For example, the technology of processing moon sand was also used here on Earth to make artificial soil. In that soil, about 20% more vegetables grew than in normal soil. People will be able to grow vegetables anywhere in the world with this new technology.

According to the United Nations, the world population will reach 9.7 billion by 2050. There is concern about a global food crisis. Food production technologies used in space may provide great solutions for our planet.
title: Space Food

sections:
What do birds see while flying in the sky? How often do lions hunt? How do whales sleep? “Bio-logging” may provide answers to these questions.

Bio-logging is a new scientific research method. It means to log data about the lives of wild animals by attaching a small recording device to each animal. A “data-logger” can provide a lot of useful information. However, some people may worry about its influence on an animal. Actually, its weight should be less than 3.5% of the animal’s weight. Moreover, it should never disturb the animal’s movements or activities. With the development of digital devices, bio-logging has become a successful research method.

Data-loggers collect a wide range of data about animals: from their location to their body temperature. This is how we get important data for animal research. Now is the time when we can learn many interesting facts about animals.

Bio-logging often leads to new and exciting discoveries. Let’s take the example of Weddell seals in the Antarctic. Generally, seals hunt for food more than 200 meters below sea level. However, when researchers analyzed bio-logging data about mother Weddell seals’ diving, they noticed something strange. Mother seals often swam in shallow water where there was not so much food. What were they doing?

The researchers had a clear hypothesis, but they wanted proof. Thus, they attached data-loggers to the baby seals as well in order to record their movements. They noticed the pups were swimming at the same speed and depth as their mothers. Moreover, the data-logger on one mother showed images of her pup following her. From these results, the researchers were able to confirm that the mother seals were swimming in the shallow water to teach their baby seals how to swim.

Bio-logging sometimes uncovers the truth about animals. We often hear cheetahs run up to 100 kilometers per hour (km/h). We might assume they always run at their full speed to catch their prey, but is it really true?

Research was carried out in Namibia to examine cheetahs’ behaviors. The data-loggers recorded them hunting 70 times in total. Surprisingly, the cheetahs’ fastest speed was only 60 km/h. Moreover, the average of all the top speeds was only 30 km/h. Why were these results slower than expected? Actually, this research took place in the bush, where prey couldn’t run at its full speed. Therefore, the cheetahs didn’t have to chase it at their full speed. These results show us that cheetahs are very efficient hunters.

To confirm our assumptions, we must collect a large amount of data and analyze it scientifically. That is why bio-logging can be a great tool to discover the truth about wild animals.

Bio-logging can even find out what’s happening inside animals’ bodies. Generally speaking, the bigger marine animals are, the longer they can stay underwater. For example, elephant seals, which weigh more than two tons, can stay underwater for about two hours. However, penguins, despite their small body, can stay underwater for a surprisingly long time.

Researchers uncovered how a penguin’s body works by recording its heart rate. On the surface of the sea, the heart rate was 288 beats per minute (bpm). It dropped to 137 bpm when the penguin began to dive. Only 95 seconds later, when it was about to reach the surface again, the heart rate was estimated to be as low as 27 bpm. According to the researchers, penguins use oxygen efficiently by slowing down their heart rate.

In each of these cases, wild animals’ true behaviors were uncovered by bio-logging. This method will continue to help us discover animals’ secrets for years to come.
title: Bio-logging

sections:
These days, more people are traveling than ever before. Travel can expand their worldview and leave them with great memories. Thanks to many visitors, tourist destinations create jobs and income. Therefore, a lot of countries around the world promote tourism. However, what is the impact of having too many visitors? Noise, traffic jams, and littering — all these problems are caused by “overtourism.”

Overtourism is a recent word meaning “too much tourism.” The word has been used since the middle of the 2010s, but the problem itself has a long history. It describes a situation where local people’s quality of life gets worse because of too many tourists. Today, famous destinations around the world are trying to deal with overtourism. Tourism provides a lot of benefits, but at the same time it has too many negative effects.

Many tourist sites are now suffering from overtourism. One example is Venice in Italy. It is famous for its canals and historic buildings. In 2018, there were only about 55,000 local people, but more than 20 million tourists. New hotels, restaurants, and tourist shops gradually took over local family businesses. Therefore, a lot of local people had to move to other places. Even worse, large ships caused terrible pollution around Venice. Finally, local people protested and the government made new strict rules for tourists.

Another example is Boracay, a small resort island in the Philippines. It became a must-visit location because of its heavenly beaches. The number of tourists had been increasing every year, and there were over two million visitors in 2017. However, sewage water from hotels and restaurants flowed into Boracay’s blue waters. As a result, in 2018, the government temporarily closed the island to deal with the serious sewage problem.

Overtourism happens when the number of tourists increases suddenly. It causes problems not only in foreign countries but also in Japan.

Kamakura, a famous tourist destination in Japan, has suffered from overtourism. The trains are especially overcrowded during holiday seasons. A local man said, “Sometimes I feel as if I were stuffed into a sardine can.”

In Shirakawa-go, steep-roofed houses have been lit up in winter for over 30 years. This has attracted more and more visitors recently. However, the village could not control such a large number of people. So, in 2019, it introduced a reservation system for the illuminations.

In 2013, Mt. Fuji was registered as a World Heritage Site. Nowadays, there are too many people climbing the mountain. This overtourism has caused serious problems such as too much littering and a lot of damage to nature. Now, visitors are encouraged to make a donation to protect the environment.

How can we manage overtourism? Kyoto has approached the problem from three viewpoints: time, place, and season.

Opening times were changed at some spots to deal with increasing numbers of visitors. For example, Nijo-jo Castle began to open earlier in summer than in other seasons. These changes offer tourists more opportunities to visit at different times of the day.

A famous tourist site, Fushimi Inari Taisha, attracts countless visitors. Therefore, local people have started introducing nearby sake breweries. They are becoming popular among tourists.

The most popular seasons in Kyoto are spring and fall. Kyoto is now promoting early summer to reduce crowds in the city. It hopes to spread the number of tourists more evenly throughout the year.

Overtourism is a serious problem. However, tourism brings us many economic benefits and is essential for many communities. Therefore, we must find new ways to address overtourism around the world.
title: Overtourism
